tha-ap96:1.1: Sūcidāyaka.] Kammāro 'haṃ pure āsiṃ Bandhumāyaṃ puruttame / sūcidānaṃ mayā dinnaṃ Vipassissa mahesino. // //
tha-ap96:2.1: Vajiraggasamañ ñāṇaṃ hoti kammena tādisaṃ / virāgo 'mhi vimutto 'mhi *patto 'mhi* āsavakkhayaṃ. // //
tha-ap96:3.1: Atīte ca bhave sabbe vattamāne c' anāgate / ñāṇena viciniṃ sabbaṃ sūcidānass' idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap96:4.1: Ekanavut' ito kappe sattāsuṃ Vajirasamā / sattaratanasampannā cakkavattī mahābalā. // //
tha-ap96:5.1: Paṭisambhidā catasso vimokhā pi ca aṭṭh' ime / chaḍabhiññā sacchikatā kataṃ Buddhassa sāsanan
tha-ap96:6.1: ti. // // Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Sucidāyako thero imā gāthāyo abhāsitthā ti.
